description: Crouch slightly, clap hands twice, say 'Sawubona'
Remove headgear, use indirect speech ('The Chief may consider...'), never gesture directly at the Inkosi
fail_consequence: Grave insult to royalty; -0.40 relationship; possible banishment

description: Near in-laws, substitute taboo root words with clan-specific alternates. Father-in-law's name root is avoided entirely.
fail_consequence: Social shame; -0.10 relationship with entire in-law clan

description: Right-hand clasp, then clasp with thumb raised, then plain clasp again (three-stage handshake)
Brief incline of head, 'Sawubona'; physical contact inappropriate unless family
fail_consequence: Social impropriety if physical contact made; -0.05 relationship

description: Announce arrival at the gate; wait to be invited; do not enter Sibaya unbidden
fail_consequence: Treated as hostile intruder; -0.20 relationship; potential combat

description: Send a child ahead to announce. Bring a small gift (tobacco, snuff, or beer). State business indirectly.
Accept food with both hands cupped; thank with clap before and after eating; do not eat standing
Cattle must be presented by the groom's uncle, not the groom. Negotiations conducted in formal siSwati proverb speech.
fail_consequence: Marriage considered informal; severe social stigma

description: Observe silence at the homestead. No singing or dancing for 30 days. Wear darker clothing or ashes.
fail_consequence: Seen as disrespecting the dead; -0.15 relationship with deceased's family
